push.title: W 3-0 vs GPFC Academy | You: 6.1 (worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.1 stings. Good. It means you care. Now let's turn that sting into a plan.

THE GOOD
+ Giveaways 0, down from your usual 8. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 1. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of GPFC Academy. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- On-ball actions 1, down from your usual 29. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Here's how: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
- No key passes from 1 passes. Little adjustment: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 4. Tiny tweak: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 6.1, down from your usual 8.1. Flat out: that cost us the match.

Drill of the day: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

Hey, BellyTb1. Win the next five seconds, then the next five.

Don't be hard on yourself; be honest with yourself. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 5.9 against GPFC Academy. I'm not mad. I'm motivated, and I need you motivated too.

THE GOOD
+ Misplaced passes 0, down from your usual 8. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 3. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of GPFC Academy. Team wins are the best kind.

THE BAD
- No shots. Training homework: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- On-ball actions 1, down from your usual 35. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 5.9, down from your usual 7.9. We lost the match right there.

Try this in practice: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Quiet feet, loud heart.

Every great story has a slow chapter. - Coach Lasso
